# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.


# follow up of calculation and propagation of new track residual weighting scheme
This is a follow up for the task in 20260412-1.md and 20260412-2.md.

After inspection, there are still several refresh plots needed in the overleaf. Make the following productions and plot refreshed with the new track residual corrections.
 - analysis/closure. ALL these plots should be regenerated with the newest nominal track residual correction. Specify if this was actually done - in git status it says they haven't changed, but with the new correction they should change somewhat. Explain.
 - analysis/combining. Using the same logic, these should also change but in git it is showing them as unmodified.
 - systematics standalone plots sys/*EnergyExtrapolation*, *MuonTrack*, *PU*, *TrackCorrection* and *TrackSelection* are missing from the referesh for pp, pPb and Pbp, even though the total systematics plots have been remade. Remake these "standalone" plots as well for each system. The fact that these are missing makes me suspicious the variations were not calculated with the new residual corrections. Look into this an ensure new residual corrections were indeed produced for all these and the newest factors are applied. If so, remake the standalone plots and copy to the overleaf. 
Copy all the new plots to the overleaf. Leave only used current plots made with current weights in the overleaf.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
